name: GC72 new scenario
_note: The launcher's New Scenario: a fresh deal of territory, Strategic Centers and starting units on the base scenario's map (engine/scenario_generator.py, reference/GC72 New Scenario.odt). defaults: the scenario-wide options; seat_defaults: each player seat's settings (territory_value null: the map's total split evenly among the players); neutral_defaults: the Neutral row's (territory_value null: whatever the players leave). The launcher starts from these and remembers the last ones used.
